mapper.update: UPDATE memory_recall_attempt SET revision=#{a.revision},state=#{a.state},snapshot_json=#{snapshot},updated_at=#{a.updatedAt}, revealed_at=#{a.revealedAt},rated_at=#{a.ratedAt},closed_at=#{a.closedAt},rating=#{a.rating}, invalidation_reason=#{a.invalidation.reason}NULL, last_event_sequence=#{a.lastEventSequence} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{a.id} AND card_id=#{a.cardId} AND revision=#{expected} AND state IN ('THINKING','REVEALED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memory_active_attempt WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS event_id,rate_basis_kind AS kind FROM memory_attempt_event WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND event_kind='RATE' AND count_regular=1 AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{until} ORDER BY attempt_sequence LIMIT 1

WITH SELECT COALESCE(SUM(day_position=1 AND rate_basis_kind='NEW'),0) AS new_cards, COALESCE(SUM(day_position=1 AND rate_basis_kind='REVIEW'),0) AS review_cards,COUNT(*) AS rated_events FROM day_ratings
mapper.sql: source_flags AS ( SELECT c.id AS card_id,COUNT(*) AS source_count, SUM(k.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL) AS unavailable, SUM(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.body AS BINARY) <> CAST(p.body AS BINARY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS body_changed, SUM() AS upstream_review_required, SUM(CASE WHEN k.kind='NOTE' AND k.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archived_note, SUM(CASE WHEN k.status='ACTIVE' AND v.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(v.body AS BINARY)=CAST(p.body AS BINARY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usable, SUM(CASE WHEN k.kind='CONCEPT' AND k.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archived_concept FROM memory_card c JOIN memory_card_source s ON s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.card_id=c.id AND s.version_id=c.current_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND v.id=s.knowledge_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version p ON p.owner_id=k.owner_id AND p.item_id=k.id AND p.id=k.current_version_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.status='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.id ), eligible AS ( SELECT c.id AS card_id,v.card_kind AS kind,v.title,c.current_version_id AS card_version_id,v.version_number AS card_version_number, c.revision AS card_revision,g.revision AS gate_revision,s.revision AS schedule_revision,s.cycle_id,s.phase,s.last_review_at, GREATEST(s.suggested_due_at,COALESCE(s.defer_until,s.suggested_due_at)) AS effective_due_at, CASE WHEN s.phase IN ('LEARNING','RELEARNING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS phase_rank,f.archived_concept FROM memory_card c JOIN memory_card_version v ON v.owner_id=c.owner_id AND v.card_id=c.id AND v.id=c.current_version_id JOIN memory_review_gate g ON g.owner_id=c.owner_id AND g.card_id=c.id JOIN memory_schedule s ON s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.card_id=c.id JOIN source_flags f ON f.card_id=c.id LEFT JOIN memory_active_attempt o ON o.owner_id=c.owner_id AND o.card_id=c.id WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND g.review_required=0 AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND o.attempt_id IS NULL AND f.source_count > 0 AND f.unavailable=0 AND f.body_changed=0 AND f.upstream_review_required=0 AND f.archived_note=0 AND f.usable > 0 )

WITH , , due_cards AS ( SELECT e.*,d.id IS NOT NULL AS counted_today, COALESCE(d.rate_basis_kind,CASE WHEN e.last_review_at IS NULL THEN 'NEW' ELSE 'REVIEW' END) AS budget_kind FROM eligible e LEFT JOIN day_ratings d ON d.card_id=e.card_id AND d.day_position=1 WHERE e.effective_due_at <= #{asOf} ), ranked AS ( SELECT d.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY budget_kind,counted_today ORDER BY phase_rank,effective_due_at,card_id) AS budget_position FROM due_cards d ), recommendations AS ( SELECT r.*, (counted_today=1 OR budget_position <= CASE WHEN budget_kind='NEW' THEN #{newRemaining} ELSE #{reviewRemaining} END) AS recommended FROM ranked r )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_due_cards,COALESCE(SUM(recommended),0) AS recommended_cards FROM recommendations
mapper.sql: SELECT card_id,kind,title,card_version_id,card_version_number,card_revision,gate_revision,schedule_revision,cycle_id, phase,effective_due_at,budget_kind,counted_today,recommended, (counted_today=0 AND CASE WHEN budget_kind='NEW' THEN #{newOver} ELSE #{reviewOver} END) AS requires_budget_confirmation, (archived_concept > 0) AS archived_concept FROM recommendations
mapper.select: WITH SELECT MIN(effective_due_at) FROM eligible WHERE effective_due_at > #{asOf}

SELECT c.id AS card_id,s.knowledge_item_id AS item_id,s.knowledge_version_id AS version_id,k.kind,v.version_number,k.status,k.current_version_id, CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(v.body AS BINARY) <> CAST(p.body AS BINARY) END AS body_changed, AS upstream_review_required FROM memory_card c JOIN memory_card_source s ON s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.card_id=c.id AND s.version_id=c.current_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND v.id=s.knowledge_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version p ON p.owner_id=k.owner_id AND p.item_id=k.id AND p.id=k.current_version_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.id IN ORDER BY c.id,s.position_index
